source: 549 True Purpose
target: 549 Verus Propositum

source: The young man supporting Juan Oro glanced up at Lumian, who sat beside the carriage driver with one leg bent, the other propped up.
target: Vir iuvenis, qui Iuanum Oro sustinebat, sursum aspexit Luminum, qui iuxta aurīgum currus sedebat, alterum genu flexum, alterum autem extendentem tenens.

source: His eyes blazed with undisguised anger.
target: Oculi eius manifesto furore ardenter fulgebant.

source: The carriage driver jumped in fright and desperately tried to distance himself from Lumian.
target: Aurīgus currus metu impulsus est et desperanter conatus est se a Luminum recedere.

source: However, with a horse in front of him and Lugano on his left, dodging proved impossible in his haste.
target: Attamen, cum equus coram eo esset et Lugano ad sinistram, effugere in tanta festinatione impossibile apparuit.

source: Lugano swallowed hard, blaming his employer for being overly aggressive.
target: Lugano asperrime glutit, dominum suum nimis impetuosum esse accusans.

source: Is he trying to imitate Gehrman Sparrow?
target: An conatur Gehrman Sparrow imitari?

source: But his employer hadn’t exhibited such madness before; instead, he seemed intelligent!
target: Sed dominus eius talem insaniam antea non demonstraverat; immo, intelligens videbatur!

source: Juan Oro, an elderly man with mottled black hair, seemed oblivious to the revolver pointed at his forehead.
target: Iuanus Oro, senex cum capillis atris maculatis, videbatur revolveri in fronte eius directo non animadvertisse.

source: He turned his head, stepped aside from the firearm, and continued forward.
target: Caput vertit, a sclopeto se recessit, et iter continuavit.

source: Observing this, Lumian pulled the trigger without hesitation.
target: Illud observans, Lumian sine mora manubrium premere constituit.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: A yellow bullet shot from the revolver, heading straight for the side of Juan Oro’s head.
target: Globulus flavus e revolvero emissus est, recta ad latus capitis Iuan Oro tendens.

source: At some point, a palm intercepted the bullet, causing it to decelerate and spin.
target: Aliquando, palma bullam interceptavit, quae retardationem atque verterationem ei attulit.

source: The bullet landed in the palm, feeling as if it had fallen into a thick swamp.
target: Bulla in palma cecidit, quasi in paludem densam lapsa esset.

source: The wide, bronzed hand belonged to the young man supporting Juan Oro.
target: Manus lata, aenea, iuveni, qui Iuanum Oro sustinebat, pertinebat.

source: He glared at Lumian, his lips curling in disdain. Then, he bellowed, “Have you lost your mind?”
target: Iuvenis Luminum aspexit, labris in fastidio contractis; tum exclamavit: “Mentem amisisti?”

source: Before he could finish, fiery crimson orbs, nearly white in hue, materialized right in front of him, barely a meter away.
target: Antequam finire posset, orbes rubri flammei, paene albi colore, statim ante eum apparuerunt, vix uno metro distantibus.

source: They surrounded him in a blaze.
target: Eum circumdederunt igni ferventi.

source: Almost instantly, Lumian felt as though he’d been ripped from reality.
target: Fere statim, Lumian sensit quasi ex realitate eriperetur.

source: The carriage disappeared from beneath him, the ground vanished from his sight, and he found himself in an endless void of darkness.
target: Currus a sub eo evanuit, terra ex conspectu eius evanuit, atque se in vacuo interminabili tenebrarum invenit.

source: The crimson fireballs, almost white, were controlled by an unseen force and changed direction, hurtling down from their original path.
target: Globuli rubri ignis, paene albi, a vi invisibili moderabantur et cursum mutaverunt, e via originaria praecipitant.

source: Rumble!
target: Fragor!

source: They collided with the roadside dozens of meters away, carving deep, massive craters.
target: Collisuerunt cum latere viae, decem metris procul, crateres profundos et ingentes secantes.

source: The horses, startled, reared up, neighing in terror.
target: Equi, turbati, surrexerunt et in timore hinnientes.

source: The carriage driver instinctively pulled at the reins, struggling to calm the panicked animals.
target: Aurīgus currus instinctu funibus traiecit, animalia perturbata sedare conans.

source: The “illusion” Lumian experienced dissolved with the explosion.
target: Illusio quam Lumian experiebatur, cum explosione dissoluta est.

source: He saw Juan Oro and the lad again.
target: Iterum Iuanum Oro et puerum conspexit.

source: Juan Oro, deeply wrinkled with his beard and hair standing on end, lifted his black cane and growled in a low voice, “Have you had enough?”
target: Iuanus Oro, barba profunda rugosa et capillis erectis, baculum nigrum attollens, voce gravi increpavit: “Satisne habes?”

source: Lumian grinned and raised his revolver once more, aiming it at the president of the Fisheries Guild.
target: Lumian subridens revolverum iterum elevavit, ad praesidem Gildis Piscandi intendens.

source: At that moment, Rubió Paco’s voice echoed from the rear carriage.
target: Illo momento, vox Rubió Paco ex parte posteriori currus resonavit.

source: “Let them through,” he spoke in Intisian.
target: “Transeant,” in Intisiana dixit.

source: Only then did Lumian lower his arm and offer a smile in Intisian.
target: Tum demum Lumian brachium deponens et in Intisiana subridens locutus est.

source: “My employer says you’re free to pass.”
target: “Dominus meus dicit te libere transeare.”

source: He acted as if he couldn’t comprehend Juan Oro and the lad’s Highlander.
target: Se gessit quasi linguam Highlander Iuan Oro et pueri comprehendere non posse.

source: Juan Oro observed him for a moment before shifting his attention.
target: Iuanus Oro eum paulisper observavit antequam attentionem suam verteret.

source: Using his cane, he circled around to the side of the carriage.
target: Baculo suo utens, ad latus currus circumivit.

source: The lad supporting him shot a glare at Lumian, but he was at a loss for cuss words since Lumian couldn’t understand.
target: Puer, qui eum sustinebat, Luminum intuebatur, sed verba obscena invenire non poterat, quoniam Lumian non intellegebat.

source: Juan Oro glanced at the window and calmly inquired, “Martha, I heard you’re not feeling well?”
target: Iuanus Oro ad fenestram aspexit et tranquille inquit: “Martha, audivi te non bene esse?”

source: “Yes,” the old lady weakly replied through the glass.
target: “Ita,” respondit vetula per vitrum debiliter.

source: Juan Oro nodded.
target: Iuanus Oro annuit.

source: “Has the Governor given you permission to seek treatment? Do you need my help in pleading your case?”
target: “Num Praefectus tibi licentiam dedit ut curationem quaeras? An auxilium meum in causa tua petenda opus est?”

source: “He’s already given permission,” Rubió replied on behalf of his mother.
target: “Iam concessum est,” Rubió pro matre sua respondit.

source: “That’s good.” Juan Oro nodded slightly and didn’t press further.
target: “Id bonum est.” Iuanus Oro leviter annuit et amplius non insistit.

source: He turned and slowly walked toward the building housing the Governor of the Sea’s residence, using his cane as a crutch.
target: Se convertit et lente ambulavit ad aedificium sedis Praefecti Maris, baculo suo uti scapula.

source: The young man supporting him shot a final glare at Lumian before refocusing on the old man.
target: Iuvenis, qui eum sustinebat, Luminum ultimam intuebatur, deinde ad senem rediit.

source: Lumian adjusted his posture, acting as if nothing had transpired. He said to Lugano, “The carriage can continue forward.”
target: Lumian se statim constituit, quasi nihil fuisset, et ad Lugano dixit: “Currus procedere potest.”

source: Lugano snapped out of his daze and quickly directed the startled carriage driver to soothe the horses and exit Milo Village as soon as possible.
target: Lugano ex stupore egressus est et celeriter aurīgum currus instruxit, ut equos sedaret et ex vico Milo quam primum exiret.

source: Without any issues, they made their way back to 21 Saint Lana Street.
target: Sine ulla difficultate, iter redierunt ad 21 Plateam Sanctae Lanae.

source: Lumian retrieved Ludwig, his mouth still glistening with oil, from Giorgia and smiled at Rubió Paco.
target: Lumian Ludwig, cuius os adhuc oleo nitidum lucebat, a Giorgia recepit et Rubió Paco subridens aspexit.

source: “Remember your promise. Otherwise…”
target: “Memento promissionis tuae. Aliter…”

source: He smiled and left the statement hanging.
target: Subridens, dictum in suspenso reliquit.

source: “Don’t worry,” Rubió replied in Intisian.
target: “Noli timere,” Rubió in Intisiana respondit.

source: After Louis Berry, his godson, and the interpreter departed, Giorgia sighed in relief and glanced at her husband.
target: Postquam Louis Berry, filius spiritualis eius, et interpretus discesserunt, Giorgia leviter suspiravit et ad maritum suum aspexit.

source: “I’ve never seen a child eat so much. He must be abnormal!”
target: “Numquam vidi puerum tam multum edentem. Extra ordinem esse debet!”

source: “Otherwise, Louis Berry wouldn’t have let him stay with us so easily,” Rubió responded, unfazed.
target: “Aliter, Louis Berry eum non sineret tam facile nobiscum manere,” Rubió respondit, impassibilis.

source: Aquina Street, Solow Motel.
target: Via Aquina, Solow Motel.

source: After shutting the door, Lugano couldn’t resist asking Lumian, “W-why were you so aggressive? He’s the president of the Port Santa Fisheries Guild, a big shot. And, we’re in Milo Village!”
target: Postquam ostium clausit, Lugano non potuit se continere rogare Luminum: “Cur tam impetuosus fuisti? Ipse praeses Gildis Piscandi Portus Sanctae est, vir magnus. Et nos in vico Milo sumus!”

source: He suspected his employer had some hidden agenda.
target: Suspicabat dominum suum aliquod occultum propositum habere.

source: Lumian gave his guide a glance and grinned.
target: Lumian ducem aspexit et subridens fēcit.

source: “Why else? When making a scene in public, it’s unlikely both parties can go all out. It’s the perfect chance to test them, see what they’re made of. Trying it under the cover of night, when no one cares about the Earth Mother Church’s authority and the Feynapotter government? That would be way too risky.”
target: “Cur aliter? Cum in publico scaenam fingis, vix utrumque totum se dare potest. Occasio perfecta est eos probandi, quid sint facti. Conari hoc sub tegmine noctis, cum nemo de auctoritate Ecclesiae Matris Terrae et regimine Feynapotter curat? Id nimis periculosum esset.”

source: If Lumian had discovered that Juan Oro had godlike powers, he’d need to act quickly and call for backup!
target: Si Lumian detexit Iuanum Oro divinam potentiam habere, celeriter agere et subsidium vocare debuisset!

source: “Ah, I see…” Lugano had an epiphany.
target: “Ah, intelligo…” inquit Lugano, habens epiphania.

source: His employer’s craziness was just a facade. Every radical move had an ulterior motive!
target: Follia domini eius merum simulacrum erat. Omnis motus radicalis causam ulterioris habebat!

source: But why is he in Port Santa? Is he planning something during the sea prayer ritual? Why target people from the Fisheries Guild?
target: Sed cur in Portu Sancta est? Num quid in ritu precationis maris parat? Cur homines ex Gilde Piscandi petere conatur?

source: That sounds very dangerous!
target: Id valde periculosum sonat!

source: Should I resign early and forget about the remaining paycheck?
target: Num ante tempus dimittere et reliquam mercedem obliviscere debeam?

source: Lumian observed the silent interpreter and strolled over to a reclining chair in the living room, settling in with a smile. He leaned back and relaxed.
target: Lumian interpreter silentem observavit et ad sellam reclinabilem in conclavi se contulit, subridens. Se recubavit et quietus est.

source: What he’d told Lugano was just one layer of the motivations behind his recent actions—the most surface-level one.
target: Id quod Luminum Lungano dixerat, erat solum unum stratum motivationum actionum recentium eius — maxime superficiale.

source: Most importantly, Lumian aimed to send a clear message with his radical actions:
target: Maxime, Lumian intendebat nuntium perspicuum per actus radicales suos transmitti:

source: He was in Port Santa to investigate the sea prayer ritual, unafraid of the Fisheries Guild or Milo Village. He possessed the strength and courage to back it up!
target: Ipse in Portu Sancta erat ut ritum precationis maris indagaret, nec Gildem Piscandi nec Vicum Milo timebat; fortitudinem et audaciam ad id confirmandum habebat!

source: Breaking into the Governor of the Sea’s residence or casually pointing a gun at Juan Oro’s head and firing—all of it was to convey this information.
target: Intrandi sedem Praefecti Maris aut leviter ad caput Iuanum Oro sclopetum intendere atque ignem emittere — omnia ad hanc informationem tradendam erant.

source: Lumian believed there were dissatisfied people in Port Santa regarding the Fisheries Guild’s sea prayer ritual. After all, the primary beneficiaries were fishermen, sea merchants, and those in related industries, not representative of the entire Port Santa population.
target: Lumian credidit in Portu Sancta homines esse dissidentes de ritu precationis maris Gildis Piscandi; nam principales beneficiarii erant piscatores, mercatores maris, et alii in industriis connexis, qui totum populum Portus Sanctae non repraesentabant.

source: For instance, even though the Church of Earth Mother and the Port Santa government had allowed the Fisheries Guild autonomy and excluded outsiders from involvement, someone bold enough to investigate, regardless of consequences, might tempt others. Could they silently or even covertly support this person to stir up trouble for their benefit?
target: Exempli causa, quamquam Ecclesia Matris Terrae et gubernatio Portus Sanctae Gildem Piscandi autonomiam concesserunt et externos a participatione excluserunt, aliquis audax ad investigandum, consequentias non curans, alios fortasse concitare posset. Possentne tacite aut etiam occulte hunc hominem sustinere ad tumultum pro suo commoditate excitandum?

source: Likewise, the beneficiaries wouldn’t be united. Some gaining meant others losing; the powerful had jealous rivals. While not wanting the sea prayer ritual to end, they likely desired those in power to suffer and vacate their positions.
target: Similiter, beneficiarii non erant unitate. Quidam lucrabant, alii amittebantur; potentes invidiosi rivales habebant. Neque volentes ritum precationis maris finiri, verisimiliter optabant ut potentes pati et munera sua relinquere.

source: Lumian, by setting up a flag to investigate the sea prayer ritual and displaying decisiveness, steadfastness, and strength, didn’t need to painstakingly gather clues. From his residence, he could receive various pieces of information, openly and covertly, and compare them to determine authenticity.
target: Lumian, vexillum ponens ad ritum precationis maris investigandum et decisionem, constantiam, ac fortitudinem ostendens, non necesse habebat accuratissime indicia colligere. Ex domo sua varias informationes, sive patentiter sive occulte, accipere et comparare poterat ut authenticitatem determinaret.

source: For an outsider with limited time, this was the fastest and most effective way to uncover the entire sea prayer ritual process and the truth about last year’s accident.
target: Pro extraneo cum tempore limitato, haec erat via celerrima et efficacissima ad totum processum ritus precationis maris et veritatem de casu anni praeteriti detegendum.

source: For the key member of April Fool’s lurking in the shadows, possibly setting a trap, this was a strategic move to draw attention to adventurer Louis Berry and raise suspicion.
target: Pro membro clavem Aprilis Stultorum, qui in umbris insidet, fortasse insidias parans, haec consilium erat strategicum ad adventatorem Louis Berry attrahendum et suspicionem excitandam.

source: In due time, armed with the acquired information and discovered clues, Lumian had a chance to expose them through their own trap.
target: Tempore debito, cum informationes adeptas atque indicia detecta haberet, Lumian occasionem habuit eos per suas insidias revelare.

source: Of course, the main drawback of this plan was its relative danger. Putting himself in the spotlight was a risk, but in the pursuit of prey, risks were inevitable. Moreover, Lumian had plenty of allies.
target: Certe, principalis defectus huius consilii erat periculum eius relativum. Se in lucem poni periculum erat, sed in praedandi conatu pericula ineluctabilia erant. Praeterea, Lumian multos socios habebat.

source: As these thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind, he realized that becoming a Conspirer had given him a clearer understanding of the situation and the conflicts between various groups. Using a term favored by Aurore, he developed a deeper insight into conspiracies: “The most brilliant conspiracy is an open conspiracy!”
target: Dum hae cogitationes per Luminum mentem percurrebant, intellexit quod conspiratorem fieri ei clariorem intellectum de re et conflictibus inter diversos coetus dederit. Verbum a Aurore amatum adhibens, perceptionem profundam de coniurationibus evolvit: “Optima coniuratio est coniuratio aperta!”

source: This became a key principle for his future acting.
target: Hoc factum est principium cardinalem pro futuris eius actibus.

source: Around 2 p.m., Lumian spotted his messenger, Penitent Baynfel, emerging from the void and handing him a letter.
target: Circiter hora secunda post meridiem, Lumian nuntium suum, Penitentem Baynfel, ex vacuo emergentem et ei epistulam tradentem, conspexit.

source: Puzzled, he asked, “Who’s it from?”
target: Perplexus, rogavit: “A quo haec sunt?”

source: Haven’t those he needed to communicate with already been reached?
target: Num non iam contigi sunt, cum quibus communicare debebat?

source: “It’s from the tall Demoness,” Baynfel replied.
target: “Ex alta Demonissa,” respondit Baynfel.

source: What’s up with Franca again? Lumian took the letter and began reading.
target: “Quid iterum cum Franca?” Lumian epistulam accepit et legere incepit.

source: The man she and Jenna encountered on the fourth level of the catacombs is suspected to be from the world where the Celestial Master resides—the world before her transmigration?
target: Vir, quem illa et Jenna in plano quarto catacumbarum invenerunt, suspicatur ex mundo esse, ubi Magister Caelestis habitat—mundo ante eius transmigrationem?

source: Lumian’s pupils dilated slightly.
target: Pupillae Luminum paulo dilatatae sunt.

source: This was different from the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society; they had transmigrated through their souls, but these individuals had brought their bodies over!
target: Hoc differebat a membris Societatis Investigandae Simiorum Crispis Capillis; illi per animas suas transmigraverunt, sed hi corpora sua attulerunt!

source: In the midst of his surprise, Lumian pondered a crucial question.
target: In medio stuporis sui, Lumian quaestionem crucem meditatus est.

source: Why would someone like that venture into the fourth level of the catacombs?
target: Cur aliquis talis in planum quartum catacumbarum ingredi ausus esset?

source: Was it because the Samaritan Women’s Spring lay sealed there, along with the River Styx’s overflowing water that bridged the two worlds?
target: Num quia fons Feminarum Samaritanarum ibi clausus iacebat, una cum aqua exuberante fluminis Styxi, quae duos mundos coniungebat?

source: Had similar individuals entered our world before? If so, why hadn’t they left any trace like Emperor Roselle and the other transmigrators?
target: Num similes homines ante in nostrum mundum intraverunt? Si ita, cur nullum vestigium reliquerunt, ut Imperator Roselle et ceteri transmigratores?

source: Franca and Jenna’s expedition to the fourth level of the catacombs appears laden with coincidences. Not only did they uncover a new Mirror World Fragment, but they also encountered such a person.
target: Expeditio Francae et Jennae ad planum quartum catacumbarum coincidibus plena videtur. Non solum novum Fragmentum Mundi Specularis detexerunt, sed etiam talem hominem convenere.

source: After penning a letter to Franca, Lumian was about to request Lugano to translate today’s newspapers when footsteps echoed from the corridor.
target: Postquam epistulam Francae scripsit, Lumian paulo petere parabat, ut Lugano diurnos hodiernos transferret, cum vestigia pedum ex corridorio resonarent.

source: His eyebrows twitched as he pulled up an armchair, facing the door.
target: Supercilia eius convulsa erant, dum sellam levabat, ad ostium spectans.

source: Knock, knock, knock. A few seconds later, a knock resounded on their suite’s door.
target: Toc, toc, toc. Post paucas secundas, pulsus in ianuam conclavis eorum resonavit.

source: “Who is it?” Lugano inquired.
target: “Quis est?” inquit Lugano.

source: A mature and gentle voice floated from beyond the door.
target: Vox matura et mitis e trans ianuam effluens audiebatur.

source: “I’m Noelia of the Fertility Order.”
target: “Ego sum Noelia Ordinis Fertilitatis.”

source: Upon hearing this name, Lumian leaned back slightly and offered a smile.
target: Audito hoc nomine, Lumian paulum se recubavit et subridens ostendit.

source: He sensed that his digestion of the Conspirer potion had progressed a bit further.
target: Sensit digestionem potionis Conspiratoris paulum longius processisse.
